info.prompt: An ultra-detailed 3D render of the Neo-Gothic game board with obsidian neural core styling, showcasing crimson standard bombs and prismatic rainbow bombs mid-explosion amidst cascading ice-locked and portcullis-barred special tiles, all backlit by pulsating arterial crimson energy trails that follow the player's last chain selection, the scene framed by alabaster UI panels with liquid gold circulatory lines that throb in sync with the multiplier ladder's heartbeat-like audio feedback.
